newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-GOLOTA BACK INJURY KO'S FIGHT WITH MERCER.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-GOLOTA BACK INJURY KO'S FIGHT WITH MERCER.

text.p: A lower back injury suffered in training has forced heavyweight contender Andrew Golota to postpone his May 16 Madison Square Garden bout against Ray Mercer, promoters announced on Thursday.
An MRI revealed two disc protrusions in Golota's lumbar spine, according to the fighter's physician, who recommended that the Polish-born boxer rest at least three weeks before resuming training.

Golota (28-2, 25 knockouts), the 1988 Olympic heavyweight bronze medallist, would have been entering the ring for the first time since his disqualification for a series of low blows against Riddick Bowe in December in Atlantic City.
Mercer (24-4-1, 16 knockouts), the 1988 Olympic heavyweight champion, most recently outpointed Tim Witherspoon on the same December card.
